subject: Request for concession after repeated latency spikes impacting BrightWave production
content:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@brightwave.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightWave Support <support@brightwave.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Repeated latency spikes — request for credit and remediation plan

Hi Soojin,

We experienced multiple latency spikes this week that pushed several important inference calls past our 2s P95 SLA and caused downstream job failures. The spikes happened on 2027-03-15 (morning window) and again on 2027-03-16 (late afternoon). Our production telemetry shows a 3-5x increase in 95th percentile latency during those windows, and a 4-hour total outage to specific endpoints while retries queued.

This has tangible business impact for us — two customers reported delayed reports and one scheduled campaign failed to run. We're requesting a formal concession (credit and a short complimentary period) while Redwood completes the post-incident remediation and provides assurance it won't recur. Specifically:
- $30,000 credit against our next invoice OR
- Two months of complimentary service for the impacted capacity tier

Please escalate this internally and let me know what is possible. We appreciate Redwood's responsiveness so far (thanks for the incident updates), but we need a documented concession and a remediation commitment to close this with our leadership and procurement team.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of Platform Reliability
BrightWave Analytics

---

On Wed, 17 Mar 2027 at 16:05 Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Repeated latency spikes — request for credit and remediation plan

Team — forwarding BrightWave's ask. Quick context: BrightWave BW-2026-0412 is on a reserved dedicated plan with a 99.9% uptime SLA and P95 latency targets written into the MSA; they have had two significant latency incidents over 48hrs that impacted production. Customer is asking for $30k credit or two months free.

My assessment: there was an infrastructure regression we traced to a scheduler regression that allowed a small set of inference pools to get overloaded during burst windows. Engineering deployed a patch yesterday (INC-2027-0316) and we are running extended canary.

Recommendation for a conciliatory concession: one month free + $25,000 account credit. Rationale: preserves goodwill, limits financial exposure, and allows us to bind remediation commitments (post-incident RCA + follow-up SW patch + scheduled customer review).

Requesting informal approval from Finance and final sign-off from Laura (customer success lead / commercial exec).

Sooj

---

On Thu, 18 Mar 2027 at 09:42 Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Repeated latency spikes — request for credit and remediation plan

Sooj / Marcus —

Finance reviewed the telemetry and the impact description. We can approve up to $20,000 credit at the manager level for goodwill (one-time). Anything above $20k requires director-level sign-off due to impact on recognized revenue and reserved capacity economics. One month complimentary service (prorated) is allowable from the customer success budget but I need confirmation of the exact billing lines to apply the credit.

If you want to land at $25k + one month, we need Laura's sign-off. Please ensure we attach an addendum that records the concession and that the concession won't set a precedent (language will be brief). Also include the incident RCA and the verification plan.

-Rishi

---

On Thu, 18 Mar 2027 at 15:10 Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Repeated latency spikes — request for credit and remediation plan

Thanks for the context. I approve offering BrightWave a one-month complimentary service period (prorated to impacted capacity tier) plus a $25,000 one-time account credit as a commercial concession.

Conditions:
- We document the concession in a short addendum to the MSA and have an authorized signatory execute it (DocuSign).
- We attach the incident RCA (INC-2027-0316) and a verification plan stating how we'll monitor the canary and what metrics will trigger follow-ups.
- Sales / CS must ensure the HubSpot deal notes and renewal forecast reflect this concession and that the credit is applied to the next invoice only.

Marcus — please prepare the addendum draft and send to Legal if needed; Soojin — inform the customer and attach the addendum + RCA + incident summary. Rishi — finance will apply the credit code once DocuSign is complete.

Laura
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---

On Thu, 18 Mar 2027 at 16:25 Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@brightwave.ai>
Cc: BrightWave Support <support@brightwave.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Concession offer and next steps (BrightWave)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for escalating and for your patience while we reviewed the telemetry and remediation work. Redwood is prepared to offer the following concession to BrightWave Analytics as a gesture of goodwill for the two latency incidents on 2027-03-15 and 2027-03-16: 

Offer details (approved):
- One month of complimentary service (prorated to the impacted dedicated capacity tier)
- $25,000 one-time account credit applied to BrightWave's next invoice

What we will deliver by Friday 2027-03-25:
- Final incident RCA (INC-2027-0316) and a one-page summary (attached: incident_report_summary.xlsx)
- Verification plan and platform changes we've deployed to prevent a recurrence
- A short concession addendum for signature (attached: concession_addendum_draft.pdf). The addendum records the concession and includes a non-precedent clause.

Action items for BrightWave:
1) Review the concession addendum and sign via DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/SigningStart?token=abc123-brightwave
2) Confirm preferred billing line to apply the credit (AP contact)

If you sign the addendum, Finance will apply the credit against your next invoice. If you prefer the alternate (two months free), we can discuss but that will require a different commercial approval path and is unlikely to be approved at the current level.

Attachments (stubs): concession_addendum_draft.pdf (PDF), incident_report_summary.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks again — I’ll schedule a 30-minute review for next week to walk through the RCA with your team.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
